import PV_L2C_VecWrite
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_VecBack
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_L2C_VecRead

/-- Name the Vec-typed restoration explicitly, retaining the write. -/
def back {A : Type} (v : alloc.vec.Vec A) (r : Usize) (x : A) : alloc.vec.Vec A :=
  ⟨(Slice.set (alloc.vec.Vec.deref v) r x).val,
    (Slice.set (alloc.vec.Vec.deref v) r x).property⟩

theorem index_mut {A : Type} {n : Nat} (hn : n≤Usize.max) (f : Fin n → A)
    (r : Usize) (hr : r.val<n) :
    alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice A) (vector hn f) r=
      ok (f ⟨r.val,hr⟩, back (vector hn f) r) := by
  change (do let x ← Slice.index_usize (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (vector hn f)) r
             ok (x,back (vector hn f) r))=_
  rw [read hn f r hr]
  rfl
#print axioms index_mut

theorem write {A : Type} {n : Nat} (hn : n≤Usize.max) (f : Fin n → A)
    (r : Usize) (hr : r.val<n) (x : A) :
    back (vector hn f) r x=vector hn (fun i => if i.val=r.val then x else f i) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (PV_L2C_VecWrite.write hn f r hr x)
#print axioms write
end PV_L2C_VecBack

import PV_L2C_ExtractedRows
import PV_L2C_VecBack
import PV_L2C_VecShape
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_OwnedBalance
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverBalance9
open PV_L2C_NativeQ PV_L2C_QBalance PV_L2C_ReferenceQ PV_L2C_ExtractedRows PV_L2C_VecRead
open R1Z.ProverCommitBalanceRecursion

abbrev rows : List Usize := rowSequence 1024 0#usize

theorem rows_bounded : ∀ r∈rows,r.val<1024 := by
  intro r hr
  have hm : r.val∈rows.map (fun r => r.val) := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨r,hr,rfl⟩
  rw [rows,sequence_ascending 1024 0#usize (by decide)] at hm
  have hb := List.mem_range'.mp hm
  have hz : (0#usize).val=0 := by scalar_tac
  rw [hz] at hb
  omega
#print axioms rows_bounded

def output (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (d : Usize) : Fin 1024 → Q :=
  fun i => if i.val=d.val then subQ zero (foldQ (selected table active d rows) zero) else table i

theorem complete_result (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool)
    (d : Usize) (hd : d.val<1024) (ha : active ⟨d.val,hd⟩=false) :
    prover_commit_reference.balance_qm31_owned
      (vector bound1024 (fun i => source (table i))) d (PV_L2C_VecRead.active active)=
      ok (.Ok (),vector bound1024 (fun i => source (output table active d i))) := by
  have hlen : alloc.vec.Vec.len (vector bound1024 (fun i => source (table i)))=1024#usize :=
    PV_L2C_VecShape.length bound1024 (fun i => source (table i))
  rw [qm31_owned_fold,hlen]
  simp only [bne_self_eq_false,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
  rw [PV_L2C_VecShape.active_read active d hd]
  simp only [ha,bind_tc_ok,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
  rw [← source_zero,fold_source table active d (rowSequence 1024 0#usize) rows_bounded zero]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,sub_source]
  rw [PV_L2C_VecBack.index_mut bound1024 _ d hd]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [PV_L2C_VecBack.write bound1024 _ d hd]
  have he : (fun i : Fin 1024 => if i.val=d.val then
      source (subQ zero (foldQ (selected table active d rows) zero)) else source (table i))=
      (fun i => source (output table active d i)) := by
    funext i
    unfold output
    split <;> rfl
  rw [he]
#print axioms complete_result
end PV_L2C_OwnedBalance

import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_ConsumerBoundary25
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_L2C_HonestCaller
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R1Z R0P R0Z.ZkStatement R0Z.HonestValidity
open PV_Src_NativeInput
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]

/-- Exactly the lead's honest carrier; no guard result is added. -/
abbrev Family := {i : Input // PV_RunJoin_ConsumerBoundary25.HonestInput (K:=K) i}

def inputs (i : Family (K:=K)) : Input := i.val
abbrev source := PV_Src_NativeIdentification.prover (K:=K) (inputs (K:=K)) PV_Src_Transport.transport

def target : Family (K:=K) → BuilderCanonical.Instance (K:=K) :=
  PV_RunJoin_UniversalBuild22.toInstance (inputs (K:=K)) (fun i => i.property.1)

/-- Universal caller transport through the actual returned compiler payload.
The compiler-success, Checked and frontier facts are projected from honesty. -/
theorem identification : BuilderSource.SourceIdentification (source (K:=K)) target :=
  PV_RunJoin_UniversalBuild22.identification (inputs (K:=K)) (fun i => i.property.1)
    (fun i => i.property.2.1) (fun i => i.property.2.2.1) (fun i => i.property.2.2.2)
#print axioms identification

/-- The guard caller's cached columns are the bank actually returned on this input. -/
theorem returned_bank (i : Family (K:=K)) :
    ∃ banks, BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.CopyRecords.banks
        (PV_RunJoin_UniversalBuild22.records i.val) = ok (some banks) ∧
      i.val.compiled.semantic_c1.c1 = banks.merged :=
  PV_RunJoin_UniversalBuild22.returned_bank i.val i.property.2.1
#print axioms returned_bank

theorem field_large : 4096 < Fintype.card K := by
  have hc : Fintype.card (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) ≤ Fintype.card K :=
    Fintype.card_le_of_injective (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K)
      (RingHom.injective _)
  rw [ZMod.card] at hc
  have hp : AspisCircleGroupOrder.P = 2147483647 := rfl
  rw [hp] at hc
  omega
#print axioms field_large

/-- Soundness of the decoded raw trace for every input in precisely Family.
This does not assert canonicality of the native U32 representation. -/
theorem builder_sound {CommitHandle : Type} (F : Subfield K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    BuilderSoundOn (source (K:=K)) B x :=
  BuilderSource.builder_refinement_D46_D51 field_large F B x source target identification
#print axioms builder_sound

theorem transfer : PV_RunJoin_ConsumerBoundary25.HonestInput (K:=K)
    PV_RunJoin_AdmittedCarrier23.transfer := PV_RunJoin_ConsumerBoundary25.transfer_honest
#print axioms transfer

theorem withdrawal : PV_RunJoin_ConsumerBoundary25.HonestInput (K:=K)
    PV_RunJoin_AdmittedCarrier23.withdrawal := PV_RunJoin_ConsumerBoundary25.withdrawal_honest
#print axioms withdrawal
end PV_L2C_HonestCaller
